title: Data Analyst role - Finance and lending sector
text: Data Analyst role - Finance and lending sector at Match Executive (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). You will be a key member and influential player in this already successful and growing team. As this is a newly created role you will work with a departmental team of five to achieve goals and to help set the agenda for the business. In this exciting role you will: Update and enhance the current financial forecasting model Develop modelling and reporting tools to manage debt providers Develop and build modelling and reporting tools to allow the client to move and develop a debt securitisation product and have products rated by the relevant agencies Develop and build reporting and forecasting tools for interest rate management/derivate functions Be responsible for data mining along with senior management. Design and build data mining tools that will allow them to analyse the significant amount of customer data they have in their risk, and customer loans areas. This is a fantastic role for you to really take the lead and help to set the agenda. To be successful in the role its important you have experience: In a similar role with in a financial organisation. Relevant tertiary qualifications Excellent Excel skills Good team work and communication skills A strong background in "Big Data" and analytical reporting The ability to work autonomously An investigative mind Strong commercial acumen If this role sounds great to you and you are keen to discuss it further, please click on the link and apply today
